source.note: Archive AMIKO_Impluse_T2C_2.5.15_emu.zip from the Amiko/Amiko HD folder on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as a dual-CPU XIP M3821 board (chips/m3821.py, run_dump_impulse_t2c_2515_app_starts.py, run_dump_impulse_t2c_2515_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader uses cache-as-RAM until DDR3 is up, drives the CH455 panel on GPIO 128 / 129 ("CH455 panel init OK!", " ON "), parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1016804, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") and maincode(AV) ("22000A882515") via LZMA, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE at 0xA6000200 with EBase 0x86002001).  The application attaches PAN_CH455_0 ("---led 455 attach OK--", " on "), initialises hs_config and MCAS key database, configures its MaxLinear MxL603 tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB2, and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog through GE_M36F.

desc: Amiko Impulse T2/C (System ID 22000A88) EMU firmware v2.5.15 for the compact Full HD DVB-T2/C terrestrial and cable receiver on the ALi M3821A SoC with 128 MB DDR3, 8 MB SPI flash, and MaxLinear MxL603 silicon tuner at I2C 0x60.
Pairs an XIP "M3821A 1.1.1" bootloader with a dual-CPU maincode(AV) + "M3606 SEE" co-processor build and an external CH455 4-digit LED/IR sensor on GPIO 128 (SCL) / 129 (SDA).
